name: Tome
description: Ebook and manga library server with web reader, OPDS and metadata fetching. A KOReader plugin records every reading session and syncs positions both ways, powering streaks, pace, heatmaps and per-book stats. ([Source Code](https://github.com/bndct-devops/tome), [Clients](https://github.com/bndct-devops/tome/blob/main/docs/koreader-plugin.md)) `AGPL-3.0` `Docker`
